description: ServiceMatch STANDARD CLASS EXTENSIONS — ServiceNow classes a destination does not ship that discovery sources need; each is a proposal the customer's administrator creates under their own scope (u_ prefix). Mirrors back_end/cmdb/class_extensions.py (pinned equal). Check ServiceNow's CMDB CI Class Models store app before adding one.

extensions.name: u_cmdb_ci_sensor
extensions.label: Sensor
extensions.why: A sensor that watches a piece of equipment (temperature, humidity, door, motion). ServiceNow ships no sensor class in the base CMDB and none in the CI Class Models IoT family; without this the records of an environmental-monitoring platform have nowhere to go but review.

fields.name: serial_number
fields.label: Serial number
fields.note: the radio or hardware id (LoRaWAN EUI-64 for SensorHubb) — the identity shared with readings and alerts

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.note: the site label; names collide across sites, never identity

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location
fields.note: the SITE — a sensor belongs to the site, never to a gateway

fields.name: u_equipment_type
fields.label: Equipment watched
fields.note: what the sensor watches (WALK_IN_FREEZER …) — the equipment itself is not a CI

fields.name: u_observed_by
fields.label: Observed by
fields.note: the platform that reports the unit

identification.note: inherits Hardware's serial-number identification; the EUI is the serial

extensions.excluded_why: coverage before condition: the unit exists and is observed; its condition stays in the platform
